_comment: Per-class teaching defaults for 2026/27 — the things a lesson build should assume WITHOUT asking Patryk every time. This file answers 'does this class get a word bank?' and 'does this class get homework?'. The timetable (who/when/where) lives in 2026-2027-timetable.md and classes-2026-27.json; this file is only about HOW to teach them. Anything Patryk has not yet told us is marked null with a note — never guess a default, ask him.
_sourceOfTruth: Patryk, 2026-07-13. Word-bank + homework rules stated in chat; timetable facts cross-checked against 2026-2027-timetable.md.
_howWordBankWorks: wordBank:true means the support worksheet gets a word bank on the Developing Apply tier and on any cloze activity. It is driven by worksheetExtras.wordBank[] or title.keywords[] in the lesson content. See CLAUDE.md 'Support worksheet' table.
